title: Umbrage Against the Machine
description: Umbrage Against the Machine — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to the Upper Umbrage Unleashed off Level 4 of MutantMania. Unleash your fury against Yammering Yancy and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Grapple with Gertie

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to the Upper Umbrage Unleashed off Level 4 of MutantMania. Unleash your fury against Yammering Yancy and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Now that the NARC Commissioner has authorized your contract, we've got to jumpstart your professional career. Forget about all that amateur stuff. Ah've booked you in the Upper MutantMania regional championship competition!

Hurry off now to the Upper Umbrage Unleashed off Level 4 of MutantMania. You'll be taking on Yammering Yancy, the current Upper MutantMania regional champ. As far as you know, he's been talking trash about you for days. Go knock his block off. Once you clean his clock, come back here and AH'll give you your cut of the winnings. Minus my percentage, of course.

Turn-in:

You beat Yammering Yancy? Ah'm speechless! Ah mean, of course you did. Ah *always* knew you were cut from the finest professional cloth. Well isn't that grand...Ah'm the manager of the newest regional champion of Upper MutantMania!

Objectives:

  • Unleash against Yammering Yancy

Level range: 82–100
